jess (Docs): Heads-up: PR #8622 updates the TypeScript SDK snippets in the API reference and adds a small migration note for client-side embed calls. Requesting a quick engineering check + one release-window approval. Prefer merge during low-traffic window.

theo (Eng): I can look. Any failing previews or CI errors?

jess (Docs): Netlify preview initially succeeded but Vercel preview shows a 404 for /assets/sdk-banner.png. Netlify and local previews look fine. CI had a warning about large asset size. Also link-checker flagged a markdown anchor mismatch in the migration guide.

rachel (DevEx): For reproducing local previews, run:

```
python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
cd docs && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
# to emulate preview static build:
MKDOCS_ENV=preview mkdocs build -d site_preview
```

theo (Eng): I pulled the branch and ran `mkdocs build`. The missing asset on Vercel is because the build step hashes filenames differently when run in Docker vs local. Our Vercel pipeline uses `next/image`-style hashing in the assets plugin. Suggest we pin the asset path in the snippet to the canonical public CDN URL to avoid preview divergence.

mike (SRE): Also seeing intermittent Netlify `artifact-shard` timeouts. We've been increasing the upload concurrency but it regresses on large single-file uploads. For a quick workaround, the upload script supports `--no-parallel` to force serial shard uploads.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 warning (anchor mismatch) on docs/migration/client-embed.md: `#client-integration` referenced but heading is `Client integrations`.

jess (Docs): I'll fix the anchor in the migration doc. For the asset, would prefer not to hardcode CDN URLs in snippets; can we instead ensure build produces consistent names?

rachel (DevEx): We can change the build to use deterministic hashing by setting NODE_ENV=production and passing `--stable-hash` to the assets task. Try `export NODE_ENV=production && npm run build:docs -- --stable-hash` and push.

theo (Eng): Tested locally with stable-hash flag, Vercel preview now matches Netlify output. I'll push a small CI config tweak: `docs-ci.yml` adds `--stable-hash`. Pushed to branch `docs/8622-stable-hash`.

mike (SRE): Re: artifact timeouts, temporarily set `UPLOAD_NO_PARALLEL=1` in Netlify job for this PR. I'll open a follow-up issue to investigate shard retries.

ci-bot: Netlify preview updated: https://netlify.example/preview/8622-stable (status: success) :white_check_mark:

jess (Docs): Preview looks good. @theo can you confirm the TS snippets compile in a minimal project?

theo (Eng): Confirmed: created a tiny TS project, copied the sample, `npm install` + `tsc` passes. One minor nit: rename `client.createEmbed` to `client.embed.create` (we changed API between v1 and v2). I'll leave an inline comment.

jess (Docs): Fixed the method name and regenerated preview.

ci-bot: Vercel preview: https://vercel.example/preview/8622-stable (status: success) :rocket:

mike (SRE): I set the Netlify job env `UPLOAD_NO_PARALLEL=1` for this run. File upload succeeded. Follow-up issue: #1934 to add retry/backoff for shard uploads.

jess (Docs): Thanks everyone. Approvals: @rachel approved, @theo please mark approved once inline nit is addressed. Target merge slot: 2026-03-28 01:15 PT.

theo (Eng): Approved. Merge during window.

jess (Docs): Merged during the slot and added release note: "docs: update ts sdk examples + migration note (PR #8622)". Will open the follow-ups for CI hardening and asset hashing docs. :tada:
